per_driver_disclosure_mapping.conversion_formula: no numeric yield is disclosed anywhere in the 222-page report (full-text probe returned 2 hits, both qualitative), so yield is set to the multiplicative identity
per_driver_disclosure_mapping.assumption_reason: yield = 1 is used because the disclosed 产能利用率 is an effective-output/available-capacity ratio (yield loss already inside it). Multiplying by a numeric yield would deduct yield twice, which card_M04.md line 48 forbids. The value 1 is therefore a documented scope statement, NOT a filled-in disclosure, and the field must stay flagged as missing.
capacity is already expressed as a full-year figure, so no partial-year fraction may be applied on top (I-10: average commissioned capacity already contains the commissioning time).
SMIC's revenue line is not split into wafer revenue plus other revenue in the mapped table; left missing rather than invented. The 0.0 default is not an authorisation to zero undisclosed revenue.

frozen_tolerances.reason: 0.5% on 8,021,000 wafers is about 40,100 wafers; loose enough for disclosure rounding, tight enough to catch a wrong capacity basis

volume_side_result.verdict: FAILS the frozen 0.5% tolerance by a wide margin
volume_side_result.diagnosis: year-end monthly capacity x 12 is NOT the year-average available capacity; SMIC was expanding all year (period-end 948,000/month vs an implied average around 781,000/month), so the model's documented input ('full-year gross capacity') cannot be satisfied by the disclosure as published
volume_side_result.warning: The implied figures were back-solved from disclosed volume and must NOT be presented as disclosed parameters (I-10-A item 3 forbids reverse-engineering a parameter from revenue/volume and then calling the same-formula result verification).
